What do you think? …

Ethan Sherbondy

Thanks @rajiv\_ayyangar , the whole Product Hunt team, and the organizers of the Pitch by @Deel event for encouraging us to launch today! We’ve been building in public with our community of players for the past year putting out weekly updates, so we never really did a proper launch!

Excited to meet folks in Table Space and learn about all of your favorite tabletop games. We have an ever-growing library and active discord community of players creating their own custom game modes with the Boxtree Builder on the web. Would love to hear your thoughts and excited to see what you make inside Table Space! [...] If you have a Meta Quest or Apple Vision Pro, you can play now for free. Next up, we’ll be launching on Steam Frame and a few other exciting new devices later this year.

Othman Katim

This could be such a good way to play quick chess or a card game without setting anything up. How long does it take to hop into a game with friends?

Ethan Sherbondy

@othman\_katim Thanks for checking it out! It just takes a few seconds to hop into a game room with friends, and you can also create saved private rooms if you want to have a regular hangout with the same group of friends with a Boxtree Builder account.
